headline: Approved appointment of Tom Sheridan as Assistant Principal and accepted three staff resignations; took no action on Business Manager contract.
summary: The Board of Education met in executive session to discuss candidates for Assistant Principal at James H. Moran Middle School, staff resignations, and the Business Manager's contract. After returning to open session, the board approved the appointment of Tom Sheridan and accepted resignations from Dominic Barone, Emily Cuevas, and Reilly Braunstein. No action was taken on the Business Manager's contract.
decisions: Approved going into Executive Session, unanimous.
Approved coming out of Executive Session at 8:34 p.m., unanimous.
Approved the appointment of Tom Sheridan to Assistant Principal at James H. Moran Middle School for the 2026-2027 School Year, contingent upon proper Connecticut certification, unanimous.
Approved acceptance of the resignation of Dominic Barone effective at a mutually agreed upon date to be determined, unanimous.
Approved acceptance of the resignation of Emily Cuevas effective July 31, 2026, unanimous.
Approved acceptance of the resignation of Reilly Braunstein effective July 31, 2026, unanimous.
Took no action regarding the contract for the Business Manager.
